title: Reading the grid: how terminals turn pixels into legible text
stressor: multi-column layout, justified text with hyphenation, mixed heading sizes
notes: Self-contained single page, all CSS inline, no script, no network URLs. Designed for a 960x640 viewport (120x40 at 8x16). A three-column layout (column-count: 3, column-gap 28px, faint column-rule) with a column-spanning h1 and lede, and four in-column h2 subheadings. Body paragraphs use text-align: justify with hyphens: auto under lang="en". Prose at 15px/22px fills all three columns. White background, dark text. Prose is original, authored for the Nyala corpus.
